children: Onyx governance proposal OIP-4 becomes executable, roughly 28 hours after entering the queue. The proposal covers the proposed acquisition of Chain Technology and its intellectual property, moving the decision from voting into a state where it can be carried out on-chain.

Execution of OIP-4 would place Chain Technology's assets and IP under Onyx's control, a step that can change what the XCN protocol is built on and how it is branded. Holders and observers will track how the absorbed technology and brand rights are integrated into Onyx's product thesis and market positioning. The 28-hour queue delay is standard governance mechanics, giving participants a defined window before the proposal can take effect.
OIP-4 is now queued and will be executable in approximately 28 hours 🗳️

title: Onyxcoin: OIP-4 Becomes Executable for Chain Technology Acquisition - By 06 Sep 2026
